response.sql:
WITH site_groups AS (
  SELECT
    sp.zoneref AS site_code,
    s.insurstat AS insurance_status,
    AVG(sp.remaingb) AS avg_remaining_storage,
    AVG(sp.proccpu - sp.procgpu) AS avg_cpu_gpu_gap
  FROM scanprocessing AS sp
  JOIN sites AS s
    ON s.zoneregistry = sp.zoneref
  GROUP BY sp.zoneref, s.insurstat
),
scored AS (
  SELECT
    site_code,
    insurance_status,
    avg_remaining_storage,
    avg_cpu_gpu_gap,
    avg_remaining_storage / NULLIF(AVG(avg_remaining_storage) OVER (), 0) AS storage_ratio
  FROM site_groups
)
SELECT
  site_code,
  insurance_status,
  avg_remaining_storage,
  avg_cpu_gpu_gap,
  storage_ratio
FROM scored
ORDER BY storage_ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The CPU–GPU usage gap is CPU usage minus GPU usage, averaged across rows where both values are present. The window mean is over nonmissing group averages; if it is zero, the ratio is undefined and sorts last.
